failure_patterns.pattern: rule_ignored: Responses substituted a related fact or description for the entity or attribute requested by the clue.

rejected_edits.content: For definition clues, give the requested category term rather than a list of examples. Use the conventional canonical headword or name form supported by the directly relevant clue or source, including established plural-form labels even when referring to one instrument or category; do not mechanically singularize or pluralize for agreement. Include an article only when grammatically required.
rejected_edits.target: For definition clues, give the requested category term rather than a list of examples, and match grammatical number and necessary articles.

rejected_edits.content: For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply only the missing headword or name component when that is the requested answer. If the blank is embedded in a fixed multiword label and the requested referent is the label as a whole, return its complete conventional form rather than mechanically omitting the part already shown. Do not add clue modifiers unless they are part of the canonical answer.
rejected_edits.target: For fill-in or clue-style prompts, supply only the missing headword or name component; do not repeat information already given in the clue or add clue modifiers unless they are part of the canonical answer.
